items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: When I was with Sharky on the bandstand at the famous door

ctx.x: So you don't think about it when you go to the country clubs, say.
I don't give it a thought. But I have seen some musicians do those things. When I was with Sharky on the bandstand at the famous door, we did not smoke.
